title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Redemption Expense Payment Computation
content:
**1. Amount.** The redemption expense payment on a Repossession and Collateral Recovery case is the case's posted recovery expenses not yet removed or settled, plus the storage the payment covers. The posted recovery expenses not yet removed or settled are the expenses posted on the case less the expenses removed and less the expenses already settled, never below zero.

**2. Storage covered.** The storage the redemption expense payment covers runs through the payment date, or through the latest earliest sale date stated in any notice of intent to sell on the case when that date is earlier; the days held are the calendar days from the day after the recovery date through that end date, the class free days are deducted from the days held, the chargeable days never fall below zero nor exceed the class maximum of chargeable days, and each chargeable day is charged at the class storage fee per day.

**3. Assembly.** The redemption expense payment is assembled in this fixed order: the days not charged are deducted from the days held, the remainder is floored at zero and then limited to the class maximum of chargeable days, each remaining chargeable day is charged at its day rate together with any per-day addition, and that storage is added to the posted recovery expenses not yet removed or settled; the total is rounded to the cent.

## End date of the storage covered

| Latest earliest sale date stated in any notice of intent to sell | End date |
|---|---|
| later than the payment date, or none stated | the payment date |
| earlier than the payment date | that stated date |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures: posted and unsettled expenses of 1,000.00, a day fee of 10.00, 2 class free days)

| Recovery date | Payment date | Latest stated earliest sale date | End date | Days held | Chargeable days | Storage | Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 15 May | 20 May | 15 May | 14 | 12 | 120.00 | 1,120.00 |
| 1 May | 15 May | 10 May | 10 May | 9 | 7 | 70.00 | 1,070.00 |
| 1 May | 2 May | 20 May | 2 May | 1 | 0 | 0.00 | 1,000.00 |
